prompt: The scene presents a grand, ancient corridor defined by colossal, dark pillars and wall panels intricately carved with gold and bronze dragon motifs. A highly reflective, dark floor mirrors the ornate architecture and red fabric drapes strung overhead, while a glowing brazier emits light and smoke on the left. Dramatic, high-contrast lighting illuminates the rich textures and leads the eye towards a distant, bright opening, creating an atmosphere of solemn grandeur.
